name: Planaltina

queries.query: Planaltina DF official cadastral parcel map GIS cadastro territorial imóveis prefeitura
queries.result: Official Distrito Federal SEDUH/IDE-DF cadastral map service found. It documents registered-lot and identified-occupation layers and a public GeoPortal; the municipality of Planaltina-GO portal separately exposes certificate services but no anonymous parcel geometry service was verified.

queries.query: Planaltina DF cadastro territorial mapa parcelário geoprocessamento prefeitura
queries.result: Official Portuguese results identify the SEDUH GeoPortal as public and state that it provides exact lot location and cartographic information. The official IDE-DF ArcGIS service exposes Planaltina as Região Administrativa code 6 and a registered-lots polygon layer.

registryBasis: A first-party public cadastral map/API for the Distrito Federal identifies the Planaltina administrative region (pu_ra=6) and exposes registered-lot polygons. This is regional DF custody covering Planaltina, not a separately verified municipal Planaltina-GO parcel API.

officialSources.observation: First-party IDE-DF ArcGIS MapServer describes cadastral layers including Lotes Registrados and Ocupações Identificadas; supported query formats include JSON and geoJSON.
Layer 10 is a polygon Feature Layer named Lotes Registrados. Its schema reports source CRS EPSG:31983, native OID field objectid, and Planaltina coded as pu_ra=6.
Official SEDUH description says the public GeoPortal provides cartographic information and exact lot location.

requests.outcome: HTTP 200; service metadata fetched over normal TLS.
HTTP 200; layer schema fetched. Polygon layer, EPSG:31983 source CRS, public query capability, native objectid OID, and pu_ra=6 coded as PLANALTINA observed.

verifiedParcelResponse: Three safe ID+geometry features retained from the pu_ra=6 bounded response; no unsafe attributes requested or retained.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Distrito Federal cadastral map, including Região Administrativa de Planaltina (RA VI).
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Anonymous public layer metadata and bounded pu_ra=6 registered-lot query; exact-point registered-lot and identified-occupation probes returned no features.

nativeIdentity.provenance: Layer 10 schema declares objectid as esriFieldTypeOID; retained sample properties normalize this native identity to canonical id only.

notes: WUP point preserved exactly in latitude/longitude order. Planaltina is ambiguous nationally: this packet follows the supplied point, which lies in the Distrito Federal Planaltina region; the Goiás municipal portal was recorded as discovery context only. No coordinate shift, exact-point miss inference, login, credentials, unsafe field request, or TLS exception was used. Packet completion is not source integration or runtime admission; serial reviewer qualification remains required.
